outcome: Duration of the first stage of labour
Duration of the second stage of labour
cohort: The study included 360 nulliparous women categorized into three groups based on their pre-pregnancy BMI: lean (BMI <= 19.8), normal weight (BMI = 19.9-24.9), and obese (BMI >= 25).
finding: Deviation of pre-pregnancy BMI from the normal range is associated with adverse pregnancy and delivery outcomes.
mod_finding: The cesarean section ratio was lower in the lean group compared to the normal weight group (OR = 0.15), and instrumental delivery was more frequent in the obese group compared to the normal weight group (OR=4.6).
